text:
rhiannon.cs: Heads-up — VerdantHealth (VH-778) just expanded scope. Four new squads (search, patient-ops, localization, analytics) are onboarding this quarter. Traffic jumped ~3.4x over the last 48h. They're asking about a short Dedicated pilot in EU + long-term Private option. Looping @omar.csm to own the renewal/expansion convo.

omar.csm: Thanks Rhiannon. Do we have timing? Renewal is ~5 months out so this is a prime upsell window if pilot goes well. Any compliance constraints?

rhiannon.cs: They emphasized EU data residency for localization and near-term APAC tests. Pilot timeline: kickoff in ~4 weeks, pilot duration 6 weeks, prod roll in ~2-3 months. They want cost vs performance options (quant vs batch vs smaller model fallback).

devin.eng: First pass sizing ask: need peak & sustained qps, concurrency, token/response size distribution, and nightly batch volumes. Also confirm p95 latency target. If they need p95 <200ms that's a different sizing curve than 300ms.

rhiannon.cs: Quick telemetry dump they sent:
```
peak_qps: 820
sustained_qps: 400
avg_tokens_out: 120
batch_window_utc: 01:00-04:00
p95_target_ms: 180
concurrency_peak: 60
```

anita.am: Noted — I'll start a scoped ACV uplift calc. If we convert pilot to Dedicated + Private, there's clear seat/license upsell plus infra markup.

devin.eng: Given those numbers, recommendation (rough): 12 x A30-equivalent GPU nodes with int8 quant (or int4 if model supports it) + prefix KV caching for conversational flows. Offer autoscale + burst for short spikes. We'll aim for progressive rollout: pilot on hosted Dedicated EU-west, then phase Private VPC if legal approves.

ops-bot: Automated note: suggested pilot baseline for VH-778 = 12 A30 equiv nodes, int8 quant, enable prefix cache, autoscale policy: 2x burst for 10-min windows. Estimated cost delta vs hosted baseline: ~4.2x. Internal sizing doc: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/vh-778-sizing

omar.csm: Can we offer a 4-week technical pilot (fast track) instead of 6? If so, pricing tier + SOW needs to be ready. Also need an enablement session for their ML & infra leads to capture prompt sets and eval criteria.

devin.eng: 4-week pilot okay if we limit scope: one primary model family, controlled eval set, and short peak-hour windows. We'll put a hard cap on burst usage. Also recommend fallback policy: route <50ms-latency critical calls to quantized smaller variant.

rhiannon.cs: They've asked about audit logging and KMS integration for EU keys. @legal-bot can you flag any DPA changes or addendum required?

legal-bot: Flagged. VerdantHealth will require DPA + EU SCCs or equivalent and mention of encryption-in-use via HSM/KMS for private deployments. Starting legal review, please attach customer contact and planned data flows.

anita.am: I'll prepare ACV scenarios: conservative, mid, aggressive (with retention uplift). Also prepping renewal touchpoints — we should use pilot results as playbook evidence.

omar.csm: Action items: 1) Sizing + SOW draft (devin). 2) Enablement workshop invite + pre-read (omar + rhiannon). 3) Legal DPA review (legal-bot). 4) ACV uplift model (anita). 5) Collect eval prompts & sample traffic (rhiannon). I'll run a quick internal deal review after SOW.

rhiannon.cs: I'll upload the eval prompts and a short sample CSV of request traces before EOD tomorrow. Also asking them if APAC residency requires separate infra or just testing.

devin.eng: FYI: if they need APAC residency full-time we'd recommend Dedicated in APAC region rather than routing cross-region — latency & compliance tradeoffs. I'll include cost delta in SOW.

anita.am: Sounds good. Omar — want me to join the customer call for commercials?

omar.csm: Yes please. Let's lock the workshop for next Tue 09:30 CET. Rhiannon, can you confirm with the customer?

rhiannon.cs: On it — pinging VerdantHealth now. Will update thread with acceptance or proposed times. :white_check_mark:
